stories.title: Gates Foundation warns AI could widen inequality as foundation pledges $1B to expand access - ABC News
stories.source: Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
stories.simple_summary: The Gates Foundation is worried that AI might make rich people richer and poor people poorer, so they're giving $1 billion to help more people benefit from AI technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't directly affect you right now, but it shows big organizations are thinking about whether AI will be fair to everyone.

stories.title: AI Is Transforming Business. Now It’s Transforming the MBA Classroom
stories.simple_summary: Business schools are now teaching students about AI because it's changing how companies work.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have a small business, this is a signal that learning about AI is becoming as important as learning math or accounting — but not urgent yet unless you want to stay ahead.

stories.title: Jensen Huang took a call from Trump, and showed off something else, too
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's leader Jensen Huang took a phone call from Trump and people noticed what kind of phone he was using.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly insider tech gossip — nothing you need to worry about for your business or life.

stories.title: Sen. Kennedy readies AI ‘kill switch’ bill - Live Updates
stories.simple_summary: A senator is proposing a new law that would let the government quickly shut down AI if it becomes dangerous.
stories.why_it_matters: This is political news about possible future rules, but it's too early to know if anything will actually change — keep an eye on it if you're worried about AI safety.

stories.title: Is Big Tech’s AI slowdown a safety pact or a cartel?
stories.simple_summary: Big AI companies said they would slow down how fast they build new AI, but some people think they're just using this as an excuse to work together in unfair ways.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and engineers — it won't change what AI tools are available for your business anytime soon.

stories.title: Barack Obama, Kamala Harris call for government action on AI development
stories.simple_summary: Barack Obama and Kamala Harris are calling on the government to make rules about how AI companies develop their technology.
stories.why_it_matters: Politicians are paying attention to AI, which means rules might come eventually — but there's nothing specific happening to your business right now.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang tells Trump ‘we’re not going to let [an AI slowdown] happen’
stories.simple_summary: Jensen Huang, who runs Nvidia, told Trump he disagrees with slowing down AI development — he wants to keep moving fast.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important for investors in tech companies — it shows disagreement among AI leaders about speed, but won't affect your daily life soon.

stories.title: Oklo Has Massive Potential Due to Artificial Intelligence, but the Stock Is Sinking. Here's What I'd Do
stories.simple_summary: A financial article discusses a company called Oklo and whether its stock is a good investment, mentioning AI as a reason it could grow.
stories.why_it_matters: This is stock advice for investors — not relevant unless you're looking to invest in the stock market.

stories.title: What execs and politicians are saying about slowing down AI development
stories.simple_summary: Business and political leaders are publicly debating whether AI companies should slow down their development or keep going fast.
stories.why_it_matters: This is background on what powerful people are arguing about, but there's no concrete decision yet that affects small businesses.

stories.title: OpenAI buys smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for $300 million, report says
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI (a big AI company) bought Glass Imaging, a company that makes camera technology for phones, for $300 million.
stories.why_it_matters: This means OpenAI wants to improve how AI understands images from cameras — interesting for tech watchers, but no immediate impact on you unless you use OpenAI tools.

stories.title: Jensen Huang puts Trump on speakerphone onstage to announce robots won’t take over the world
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's leader called President Trump on stage in front of an audience to talk about robots and AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a news story about a public conversation — it doesn't mean anything specific is changing for ordinary people.

stories.title: China’s Top Spy Chief Warns A.I. Is a Threat to Party Rule
stories.simple_summary: China's top intelligence official said AI technology is a risk to the Chinese government's control.
stories.why_it_matters: This is international politics — China is worried AI could change their system, but this doesn't affect your business or daily life in other countries.
